result.title: Shifting Focus by Reliability: Geometric Fusion Modulation for Robust RGB-T Detection
result.summary: RGB-thermal (RGB-T) object detectors combine visible and thermal imagery for robust detection, but signal corruption in either stream can substantially degrade accuracy. Restoration-based methods incur significant latency and do not consistently improve downstream accuracy, raising a more direct question: rather than restoring corrupted inputs, can we efficiently adapt the detector to their varying signal quality? Conventional PEFT offers an efficient route, but its input-independent corrections cannot track diverse test-time corruptions. Our controlled corruption sweeps show that corruption types have similar effects near clean conditions but diverge increasingly with severity, motivating corruption-aware, per-input adaptation. We therefore propose PG-FM (Prompt-Guided Feature Modulation), which adapts RGB-T object detectors to the estimated corruption type and severity of each modality. Under controlled RGB-T corruption simulations, PG-FM preserves clean-set performance, improves mAP50 by up to 20.8 points on FLIR and 19.9 points on KAIST, and transfers without retraining to unmodified, naturally acquired external RGB-T datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 RGB-T 目标检测中的信号损坏问题，先用受控损坏扫描说明不同损坏类型在轻度时影响相近、重度时明显分化，据此提出 PG-FM：按各模态估计的损坏类型与严重度，用提示引导特征调制做逐输入自适应，在 FLIR、KAIST 上提升 mAP50 且无需重训即可迁移到自然采集数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按估计的信号质量逐输入调制并区分模态可靠性」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与可靠性加权的融合调制提供方法线索，但其为检测任务、不涉及 latent 推理状态，实际可迁移性需核查。
